## Importing the data

**Import the data:**


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
book_data <- read.csv("../../../../data/books.csv")
```
:::


## Prepare the data


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(dplyr)
```
:::


### Dividing years into five groups


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
rating <- book_data |>
  mutate(year1 = substr(publication_date, 1, 4),
          year = floor(as.integer(year1) / 5) *5 )
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
small_collect <- rating |>
  select(average_rating,
          ratings_count,
          text_reviews_count,
          year) |>
  rename(Average_ratings = average_rating,
         Years = year)
head(small_collect)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
